name: Dependency Security Check 🔒🕷️
description: Check for security vulnerabilities when package files are modified

actions.prompt:
Package dependencies have been modified. Please:
1. Review npm audit results for vulnerabilities
2. Check for outdated packages that need updates
3. Verify new dependencies are from trusted sources
4. Ensure no malicious packages were added
5. Check license compatibility
6. Suggest security improvements

Protect our haunted mansion from malicious spirits! 🛡️👻
